mapper.select: SELECT pi.*, o.platform_order_no, o.currency, oi.seller_sku, oi.title, oi.price, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, m.unit FROM ecom_package_item pi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = pi.order_id JOIN ecom_order_item oi ON oi.id = pi.order_item_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = pi.material_id WHERE pi.package_id IN #{id} ORDER BY pi.package_id, pi.order_id, pi.order_item_id, pi.id

SELECT pi.order_item_id AS "orderItemId", SUM(CASE WHEN pi.part_main = 1 THEN pi.qty ELSE 0 END) AS "qty", SUM(CASE WHEN pi.part_main = 1 AND p.status IN ('LABELED', 'SHIPPED') THEN pi.qty ELSE 0 END) AS "locked" FROM ecom_package_item pi JOIN ecom_package p ON p.id = pi.package_id WHERE pi.order_id = #{orderId} AND p.status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY pi.order_item_id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ecom_package_item (package_id, order_id, order_item_id, material_id, qty, material_qty, cost, trade_doc_id, trade_doc_no, part_id, part_main, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.packageId}, #{i.orderId}, #{i.orderItemId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.qty}, #{i.materialQty}, #{i.cost}, #{i.tradeDocId}, #{i.tradeDocNo}, #{i.partId}, COALESCE(#{i.partMain}, 1), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
